method: Checked official Burton US product page title and selected color variant code. A page title marked 2027 plus a 27WIN variant is recorded as 2026/27 evidence. Product ID digits are model identifiers, not EANs.

products.officialTitle: Men's Burton Ion BOA Snowboard Boot 2027
products.finding: Official product page title marks the boot as 2027; selected Summit Taupe variant code begins 27WIN.

limits: These pages establish the product season and representative variant codes, not exhaustive color, size, or regional SKU availability.
Official US product pages and their variant codes are not evidence of China retail price or current China inventory.
The Ion Step On system-compatibility restriction is model-specific and should not be generalized to regular Ion BOA.
